title: Config Action editing is tedious and has a lot of back and forth movement
summary: **Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.** Editing preset actions for configs in the new input dialog is pretty tedious, resulting in back and forth navigation of the dialogs and drawers. An example: - Copy the "Left" action ("dec") of an encoder to "Right" action, and then edit it. - in the first event's drawer (event form) click copy, - navigate back - click "+ Right", new action editor drawer opens - click Paste - select the "inc" event from preset list - Editing quick changes to custom preset RPN also needs you to open the drawer even though the RPN code is shown in the summary. Some discussion: https://discord.com/channels/608690978081210392/747343235705339924/1549402901116362753 **Describe the solution you'd like** - allow inline editing of the rpn _Code_ field with double click, similarly to renaming a config in the new wizard - allow copying an event action ("OnPress") to another action both in Action edit drawer, and in summary view - In summary view, add "Copy action..." dropdown that allows you to copy an existing action to a "free" one: - In summary for "OnPress", click "Copy to..." - Shows menu: Copy to: On Release / On Hold / On LongRelease - Select "Copy to OnRelease" for example - New Action appears in summary list - After this the new action opens automatically in drawer view, so you can edit it The number of clicks for copypaste is not reduced much, but navigation is maybe more straight forward? **Describe alternatives you've considered** Pondered if there is some other alternative that lets you get away with even less clicks **Additional context** Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
